_note: Settings for scripts/check-links.mjs. 'blockedStatuses' and timeouts (after retries) mean the site refused an automated check, not that the link is dead: they're listed as 'Blocked' in the report and don't count as broken. Links on 'skipDomains' are never requested because those sites always block bots; check them by hand in a browser now and then.

skipDomains.why: RTX careers site returns 403 to every automated request (RTX / Pratt & Whitney card).
SAIC careers site returns 403 to every automated request (SAIC card).
Air Force public sites return 403 to automated requests (hiring guide: visitor access).
